scope: Contradictory review of the local standalone packaging candidate only. This is not provider end-to-end or production certification.
applicability: Bound to docs/PREPARATION.md. Source selection, private-data exclusion, installation scripts, isolation and packaging regression are applicable; publication, existing-instance mutation and fresh provider settlement are excluded.

findings.expected: Docker Compose must use the dedicated project and configuration validated from the candidate file.
findings.actual_before_fix: The initial wrapper inherited shell environment without an explicit project argument. A conflicting COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME or configuration value could override the validated file and target another stack.
findings.minimal_fix: Pass the validated project with -p and explicitly override inherited environment with validated candidate configuration.
findings.verification: Subprocess stub confirms that conflicting shell project, n8n URL and port cannot override the validated candidate values; no Docker command executed by this test.

findings.expected: The standalone frontend must use its own operator configuration and session directory.
findings.actual_before_fix: The initial wrapper inherited PAYFLOW_AUTH_CONFIG. A shell value for another project selected that operator and session directory instead of the new bootstrap identity.
findings.minimal_fix: Set PAYFLOW_AUTH_CONFIG explicitly to the candidate's private operator file in the launch wrapper.
findings.verification: Subprocess stub confirms the candidate operator path and engine configuration override conflicting shell values; no actual frontend process or private-file read performed by this test.

checks.name: Executable workflow preservation
checks.details: All 25 nodes including the five notes, their positions and parameters, 23 connections, workflow name and settings match the source. Only root deployment metadata and credential reference id/name values are ignored by the comparison. Credential type keys remain compared. The export is inactive and all credential references are demo-specific.

checks.name: Frontend, SQL and tests preservation
checks.details: Application sources, original tests, migrations and operator setup match source bytes. The frontend manifest changes only by adding the already-used ag-studio 3.0.0 as a direct dependency. Package-lock root dependency and devDependency declarations match package.json. SOURCE_MANIFEST records the original source hashes rather than claiming every extracted file is byte-identical.

checks.name: Public source selection and sensitive material
checks.details: Only PayFlow source and required installation material are selected. Public files reviewed contained no private key literal, Google API key shape, populated provider-secret assignment or personal workspace path. The n8n container volume target is expected infrastructure configuration. Environment and operator/session files are excluded by gitignore; no private files were read by the reviewer. Pattern scans do not replace staged-tree and history review before publication.

checks.name: Bootstrap permission and import design
checks.details: Bootstrap uses a dedicated non-superuser runtime DB role, grants only read access to payflow_config and executes existing SECURITY INVOKER functions with revoked PUBLIC execution. Fresh migrations/config insert are transactional; repeat bootstrap skips seed and refuses mismatched authentication configuration. n8n is bound to loopback, PostgreSQL has no published host port, workflows mount read-only, and imported credential transport files are removed in finally. Provider credentials are optional and never printed by the scripts.

checks.name: Corrected launch isolation
checks.details: tests/bootstrap.test.cjs: three tests passed, zero failures. Conflicting Compose shell configuration and auth paths are overridden, and invalid project names fail before subprocess invocation. Tests use the public template and stubs only.

checks.name: Documentation and third-party limits
checks.details: README documents initial owner setup, inactive import/publish, runtime role, private configuration, exact migration order, supported local deployment scope and no seeded orders. English guide separates internal approval, buyer approval and confirmed capture. Provider-dependent functionality requires the installer's own credentials. Licence/provenance review and public publication remain explicitly pending.

limits.detail: The reviewer did not call Docker, n8n, PostgreSQL, Gemini or PayPal and did not mutate the existing instance. Actual clean-install and webhook integration results must be supplied separately in PREPARATION.md. Stub tests are not dynamic integration evidence.
No new provider-dependent end-to-end payment, Gemini availability confirmation, hosted demonstration licence approval, author/date certification or public remote publication is claimed.

decision: No demonstrated packaging defect remains after the two minimal launch-isolation corrections. Continue isolated integration verification and retain the publication prohibition until explicit user authorization.
